description: Washington motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Washington?
questions.explanation: Washington helmet law: all riders and passengers.
questions.remember: Washington helmets: all riders and passengers.

provenance.manual: RCW 46.37.530 Motorcycles, motor-driven cycles, mopeds, electric-assisted bicycles—Helmets, other equipment—Children—Rules

questions.q: What does Washington law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
questions.explanation: Washington: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

provenance.manual: RCW 46.61.608 Operating motorcycles on roadways laned for traffic

questions.q: What does Washington require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Washington: eye protection is required unless the motorcycle has a windshield.
questions.remember: Washington eyewear: required unless there is a windshield.

provenance.manual: RCW 46.37.530 Motorcycles, motor-driven cycles, mopeds, electric-assisted bicycles—Helmets, other equipment—Children—Rules

questions.q: In Washington, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Washington issues a motorcycle permit at 16 years at the earliest.
questions.remember: Washington motorcycle permit: 16 years at the earliest.
